title: Topic 7
japanese_text: <u>園芸</u>初心者は、まずは<u>直径</u>15cmくらいの<u>鉢</u>で育ててみると良い。また、庭で育てる場合は、<u>柄</u>の長い鎌を用意すると、しゃがまずに草刈りができるので便利だ。
english_translation: Beginners to gardening should first try growing it in a pot about 15 cm in diameter. Also, if growing in a garden, it is handy to have a sickle with a long handle so that you can weed the garden without having to squat down.
